purpose: Requirements for automatic selection between doc-link and doc-db search backends in forge query-db-* and update-db-* wrappers, covering ordering, fallback, index readiness, freshness, and notification.
summary: Overview: wrappers auto-select an available document search backend; index maintenance belongs to update-db-*
Scope and exclusions: four wrappers, ordered backend list, doc-db startup attempt, DLID writing; excludes installation, daemonization, KEY/series management, grep fallback
Preconditions and glossary: usable doc-link means search and index update both work; doc-db must return machine-readable state identifiers
FNC-001 to FNC-004: backend auto-selection, query execution, update execution with DLID assignment and git tracking, execution route notification
BL-001 default order doc-link then doc-db, configurable preference, invalid config is an explicit error
BL-002 index freshness: backend owns checks, no guessing, session-change confirmation for backends without freshness checks
BL-003 and BL-004: fallback is normal, failures after selection are faults, unprepared index needs user approval, trash state and zero documents handling
BL-005 to BL-007: current-branch series search, nonexistent paths excluded, explicit backend designation without switching, index population ownership
Non-functional requirements: observability, backward compatibility, responsiveness, availability, credential protection
Error case table mapping each condition to the required behavior
tasks: Designing or modifying query-db-rules and query-db-specs wrappers
Designing or modifying update-db-rules and update-db-specs wrappers
Implementing backend selection and fallback logic
Implementing DLID assignment and doc-link index updates
Handling unprepared index approval and trash state errors
Reviewing backend-selection design documents against requirements
Writing tests for wrapper backend behavior and error cases
Changing backend preference configuration or default order
